question: If the angles (5x - 2)° and 82° form a pair of supplementary angles, then the value of x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **supplementary angles**, the sum is always 180°.

(5x − 2) + 82 = 180

5x + 80 = 180

5x = 100

x = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First angle = (5x − 2)°

Second angle = 82°

**Formula Used:**

Sum of **supplementary angles** = 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/141a9a0abc05d2f14b979755015e2e339138aed03b6d2c270d15a5d4077c368a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (5x − 2) + 82 = 180

⇒ 5x + 80 = 180

⇒ 5x = 180 − 80

⇒ 5x = 100

⇒ x = 100 ÷ 5

⇒ x = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Supplementary Angles

Two angles are called supplementary when their measures add up to 180 degrees. They form a linear pair if they are adjacent.

Complementary Angles

Two angles are complementary if the sum of their measures is exactly 90 degrees.

Linear Pair Postulate

If two angles form a linear pair, then the angles are supplementary, meaning they lie on a straight line.</p
